Profile
Eaton Corporation plc is an Irish multinational power management company, with global headquarters at the Eaton House in Dublin and a primary administrative center in Beachwood, Ohio. Eaton has more than 85,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries. Wikipedia
